newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL to propose 3.7 pct dividend.
newsitem.headline: MOL to propose 3.7 pct dividend.

text.p: The board of Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt will propose to its annual shareholders meeting on May 28 a 3.7 percent dividend, the company announced on Friday.
Last year the company paid 0.9 percent on its 1995 results.
In a statement MOL said it had 1996 net income of 22.7 billion forints, a sharp rise from 1.2 billion in 1995.
Consolidated net revenues rose to 503 billion forints, up from 370 billion in 1995, and consolidated operating profits rose to 26.6 billion forints, compared to 6.4 billion in 1995.
Pre-tax profits were 25.3 billion forints, up from 900 million in 1995, while earnings per share were 226.1 forints in 1996, compared to 10.2 forints per share in 1995.
The Friday statement said MOL's IAS consolidated operating profits grew to 32.3 billion forints last year from 8.8 billion in 1995 while consolidated after-tax profits stood at 16.6 billion forints.
